checks.claim: 肾病处方粮是唯一有生存证据的干预
checks.reason: Full text supports renal diets prolonging survival (Table 3: Elliott 264 vs 633 d; Plantinga 210 vs 480 d; Ross ~730 d vs not reached, median all-cause survival). But the guideline never says 'only'; it also cites evidence that ESAs may 'potentially' improve survival and weak evidence RAAS blockade may help survival in severely proteinuric cats. 'Only' is an overclaim; safer: diet is the intervention with the most consistent survival evidence cited.
checks.proposed_zh: 猫 CKD 按 IRIS 分期管理；指南引用的研究显示，肾病处方粮可减轻尿毒症症状并显著延长生存（表 3：中位全因生存期 264 vs 633 天、210 vs 480 天、约 730 天 vs 未达到），是指南中生存获益证据最明确的干预；促红素类药物“可能”改善生存，RAAS 阻断仅在重度蛋白尿猫中有弱证据。

quotes.quote: In cats with CKD, renal diets have been shown to reduce clinical signs of uraemia,55
and to significantly prolong longevity (see Table 3), providing a strong rationale for their use.
Studies evaluating effect of renal diets on longevity
Reported median survival time (days, all-cause mortality)
thus phosphate restriction is thought to be mainly responsible for the improved longevity seen.
there is evidence that treatment with erythrocyte-stimulating agents (ESAs) may improve QoL and potentially survival in some cats with CKD.
However, a survival benefit from RAAS blockade in cats has not been demonstrated.
There is some (weak) evidence that RAAS blockade may have more beneficial effects (possibly on survival, QoL and appetite) in CKD cats with more severe proteinuria (eg, UPCR ⩾1.0),

checks.source: PMC4895368 full text (Europe PMC fullTextXML, OA)
checks.claim: SDMA 能检出 <20% 的 GFR 下降，早于肌酐
checks.reason: Abstract and results support SDMA detecting decline earlier than sCr under every comparison method. With the ≥14 µg/dL cutoff, SDMA rose on average 4.8 wk before sCr cutoff and 4.1 wk before GFR<2, at ~8% GFR decrease (vs 48% for sCr cutoff). The first extractor's key_results row ('SDMA ≥14 same time or 1–3 wk later than creatinine') is a misreading: that sentence compares SDMA trending with the SDMA ≥14 cutoff, not SDMA with creatinine. Caveats: 'on average' (ranges include −6%), n=8 affected X-linked hereditary nephropathy male dogs, ≥14 cutoff exceeded 8 times in one unaffected littermate; ≥16 cutoff gave 3.4 wk earlier at ~16%. Fix key_results row.
checks.key_results_fix: SDMA≥14 vs SDMA 趋势法：趋势法同时（5 只）或晚 1–3 周（3 只）——这是 SDMA 两种判读方法之间的比较，不是与肌酐比较
checks.proposed_zh: 在 8 只 X 连锁遗传性肾病公犬中，SDMA 平均在 GFR 下降不到 20% 时即升高，无论用哪种判读方法都早于血清肌酐；以 ≥14 μg/dL 为界，平均早于肌酐 4.8 周（此时 GFR 平均下降 8%，肌酐超界时为 48%），但该界值在一只健康同窝犬中也多次超出，改用 ≥16 μg/dL 仍平均早 3.4 周。

quotes.quote: Although trending improved sC r's sensitivity, SDMA identified, on average, <20% decrease in GFR , which was earlier than sC r using any comparison method.
The SDMA cutoff was set at ≥14 μg/dL, based on an established reference interval in adult dogs 11 and concentrations observed in unaffected littermates.
Using these cutoff values, SDMA increased an average of 4.1 weeks earlier than the measured decrease in GFR and 4.8 weeks earlier than sCr (Fig. 2 ).
The sCr cutoff detected a 48% (range, 39–68%) decrease in GFR whereas the SDMA cutoff detected an 8% (range, −6–24%) decrease compared with unaffected littermates.
SDMA was frequently ≥14 μg/dL in unaffected littermates, exceeding the cutoff 8 times between 13 and 33 weeks of age in 1 dog (range, 11–15 μg/dL).

calculations also were performed using an SDMA cutoff ≥16 μg/dL, which identified decreased renal function 2.75 weeks earlier than GFR and 3.4 weeks earlier than sCr, corresponding to an average 16% (range, −6–35%) decrease in GFR compared with unaffected littermates.
In contrast, SDMA increased at the same time (n = 5) or 1–3 weeks later (n = 3) when trending was compared with SDMA ≥ 14 μg/dL.

Overall, increases were observed earlier when trending SDMA as compared with trending sCr (average, 2 weeks earlier), and the decrease in GFR detected was 14% (range, −6–26%) for SDMA vs. 27% (range, 5–49%) for sCr compared with corresponding unaffected littermate GFRs.
sCr and SDMA increased within 1 week of each other in all but 1 dog, in which SDMA increased 3 weeks earlier than sCr.
In contrast, for SDMA, use of a cutoff detected decreasing renal function earlier than all other methods for sCr, SDMA, and GFR.
